Explore three views of one proposed service record. Relevant context can be reused only through agreed access and verification. A shared story does not mean every colleague sees everything.

Co-op07 · Know when to hand over.

Know when to hand over.

Care has boundaries
01 / THE FAMILIAR

Quick
where
it helps.

Approved guidance.
Checked context.

02 / THE DIFFICULT

Human
where
it matters.

Judgement and exceptions.
Policy, access and authority still apply.

Everyday, considered.

Know when to hand over.

Be quick with the familiar. Give the difficult moment to a person.

The idea

Use approved guidance for routine questions. Check identity, order access and any permitted action. Bring in a colleague when judgement, an exception or authority is needed. Do not promise an automatic refund.

Co-op08 · Start with one useful moment.

Start with one useful moment.

The first useful proof
01

One item.
One useful
beginning.

Choose an item problem.
Agree the checks and the handoff.

Resolved well.Understood clearly.No repeated story.
Everyday, considered.

Start with one useful moment.

An item problem after a grocery shop.

The idea

Agree the entry route, the checks, the permitted actions and the receiving team. Judge the pilot by useful resolution, repeated contact and whether people understood the next step. Set a baseline before comparing results.
